comments.body:
As Mugon said here Master of Steam

"This is at the end of a three-quest chain:
Battles on a Steam Ship -- London/Lisbon Maritime Mediator
Pig Delivery Request -- London/Lisbon/Seville Merchant Mediator
Steam Ship Investigation Report -- London, Lisbon Adventure Mediator

You must be and stay on a steam ship for it to appear and for the whole quest
But you can be towed in fleet, no problem".

*Today I was trying to pull this quest in Seville mediator and realised that this quest cant be pulled in seville, instead we tried Lisbon and had no trouble! :P

**Keep in mind that you should have english to pull it faster!
